brief: Long low single-slope shed about 16 ft deep and 40 ft long, walls of barn-red vertical boards with a worn white fascia, and a shallow red-painted corrugated metal roof with rust patches; the low side faces the lot and the open high side faces away from the wind. Rusty pipe gates and woven-wire hog panels pen the yard in front, with a second red shed of the same kind behind and open fields beyond. On this farm it shelters hogs at one end and the disc and planter at the other.
